item.title: Flipoff
item.description:
Status: Live (locally).

An interactive web project — CSS animations, JavaScript interactions, and a full-resolution screenshot. Sometimes a project is just about craft: making something that feels good to interact with.

Source Files

  • Repo: flipoff/ (local)
  • README: Full project description in the repo
  • Screenshot: screenshot.png (800KB, shows the current state)

Tech Stack

  • Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS
  • No frameworks, no build step
  • CSS-driven animations
  • Responsive layout

What’s in There

  • index.html — main page
  • css/ — stylesheets
  • js/ — interaction logic
  • screenshot.png — current visual state

Status

Actively being developed. Check the repo for the latest.
